bib.title: Florence: A New Foundation Model for Computer Vision

read.skipped: References skimmed only; the paper has no appendix.

question: What is a foundation model for computer vision, and can one image-text pretrained model with light adapters cover space (scene to object), time (image to video) and modality tasks?
hypothesis: A pretrained model trained on web-scale image-text data with a unified contrastive objective, plus small adapters, transfers to many vision tasks with state-of-the-art results.
contributions: FLD-900M, a 900M image-text pair dataset curated from about 3B web images
Unified image-text contrastive pretraining (UniCL) with a CoSwin-H image encoder, 893M parameters
Adapters for object level (Dynamic Head), fine-grained V+L (METER) and video (Video CoSwin)
Scalable training infrastructure (ZeRO, activation checkpointing, mixed precision, gradient cache)
State of the art on a majority of 44 benchmarks

method.summary: Two-tower model (12-layer text transformer, CoSwin-H image encoder) pretrained on FLD-900M with the UniCL bidirectional supervised contrastive loss in two stages, then adapted by Dynamic Head for detection, METER for VQA, Video CoSwin for video, or continued training and linear heads for classification and retrieval.
method.task: vision foundation model pretraining and transfer (classification, retrieval, detection, VQA, video retrieval, action recognition)

datasets.name: FLD-900M
datasets.size: 900M image-text pairs from about 3B web images; 9.7M unique queries; 7.5B tokens; 350M pairs share an identical text with other images
datasets.source: Internet images and raw descriptions; private, curated
datasets.preprocessing: ALIGN-like filtering: hash-based near-duplicate removal, small image removal, image-text relevance; sampling as in CLIP and DALL-E; short texts expanded with templates such as 'A photo of the [WORD]'; near-duplicate test images removed for zero-shot tasks

datasets.name: FLOD-9M
datasets.source: COCO, LVIS, OpenImages, Object365 merged, plus pseudo boxes on ImageNet-22K (following Zoph et al., 2020)

datasets.name: VLP corpus (MSCOCO, Conceptual Captions, CC12M, SBU, Visual Genome)
VQAv2
datasets.split: 1K val images held out, the rest merged into training; evaluated on test-dev and test-std via EvalAI server

datasets.name: ImageNet-1K, 11 Kornblith et al. classification sets, CD-FSL (CropDisease, EuroSAT, ISIC, ChestX), Flickr30K, MSCOCO, COCO/Object365/Visual Genome detection, 11 Roboflow detection sets, MSR-VTT 1K-A, Kinetics-400/600
datasets.source: public benchmarks; Birdsnap dropped because 20% of image URLs are invalid
datasets.split: Flickr30K 1K test, MSCOCO 5K test, MSR-VTT 1K-A test

models.name: Florence pretrained (CoSwin-H + text transformer)
models.architecture: two-tower: 12-layer transformer text encoder (like CLIP) and CoSwin-H (Swin with CvT convolutional embedding and patch merging), global average pooling, linear projections to a shared space

models.name: Florence V+L (METER adapter)
models.architecture: CoSwin-H image encoder + pretrained RoBERTa text encoder, co-attention fusion with Mco layers each with self-attention, cross-attention, FFN

models.name: Florence Dynamic Head detector
models.architecture: CoSwin-H + Dynamic Head (level, spatial, channel attention) with ATSS

models.name: Florence Video CoSwin
models.architecture: CoSwin with 3D conv tokenization and patch merging, 3D shifted windows, dynamic window size
models.init_from: 2D conv weights duplicated over time and divided by temporal kernel size; 2D relative position embedding duplicated along time

training.objective: UniCL bidirectional supervised contrastive loss L = Li2t + Lt2i with learnable temperature; positives are all pairs with identical text (hash key); METER trained with ITM and MLM; VQA with binary cross-entropy
training.steps: 1M iterations stage 1 (with augmented template texts), then 180K iterations stage 2 (augmented texts excluded), then 80K iterations at 384x384
training.precision: mixed (float-32 for layer norm etc., float-16 elsewhere)
training.wall_clock: 10 days (pretraining on 512 A100); 7 days (Dynamic Head on 128 A100)

other.infrastructure: ZeRO, activation checkpointing, mixed precision, gradient cache
other.imagenet_finetune: CoSwin-H at 512x512, batch 8,192, 10 epochs, cosine decay, 500 warmup steps, peak lr 0.00002
other.retrieval_finetune: batch 3,072, 12 epochs, cosine decay, 200 warmup steps, peak lr 0.00002; about 6% (Flickr30k) and 8% (MSCOCO) of ALIGN's fine-tuning epochs
other.cdfsl: 5-way, 5/20/50-shot, 600 episodes per way and shot, 100 epochs per episode, SGD with momentum; text gives 'learning rate and momentum values of 0.9/0.0002' for CoSwin and '0.99/0.01' for the adapter head (order as printed, lr/momentum order is ambiguous); horizontal flip; dropout 0.5
other.detection_finetune: COCO max side 2,500, multi-scale, 12 epochs; Object365 max side 1,333; Visual Genome max side 3,000, 24 epochs, 1x1 ROI pool for attributes
other.zero_shot_detection: CoSwin frozen; Dynamic Head trained on FLOD-9M class-agnostic as proposals, each proposal classified with zero-shot classification
other.vlp: 43 epochs, image size 384, weight decay removed on text embedding and modality embedding
other.vqa_finetune: 10 epochs, lr 8e-6, MLP head over 3,129 answers
other.video_finetune: Kinetics 384x384, 30 epochs, lr 0.0002, drop path 0.5, label smoothing, RandAugment

inference.samples: single run per benchmark; CD-FSL averaged over 600 episodes per way and shot
inference.prompting: zero-shot classification follows CLIP prompt templates, engineering and ensembling; class names as text candidates, cosine similarity ranking

other.video_views: 4x3 temporal clips x spatial crops on Kinetics

metrics.name: top-1 / top-5 accuracy
metrics.definition: zero-shot via cosine similarity of image and class-name text embeddings

metrics.name: R@1/R@5/R@10
metrics.definition: recall for image-text and text-video retrieval

metrics.name: mAP / AP50
metrics.definition: mAP averaged over IoU 0.5:0.05:0.95 for COCO, Object365 and zero-shot; AP50 for Visual Genome

metrics.name: VQA accuracy
metrics.definition: test-dev and test-std from public EvalAI server

eval.protocol: Linear probe follows CLIP; reproduction of CLIP numbers matched within +-0.1. No seeds or significance tests.

prompts.purpose: data augmentation templates for short texts

limits: Florence is below several other billion-scale models in size (authors' own statement); FLD-900M, weights and code are not released in the paper
Zero-shot detection still shows a noticeable gap to supervised learning, especially for novel domains such as BCCD and Chess Pieces
Linear probe weaker on CIFAR10/100 at 32x32 input resolution
On ImageNet fine-tuning it is slightly below CoAtNet-7 (90.88 vs 90.05), which is 3x larger in model and data
Many hyperparameters (pretraining lr, schedule, warmup, weight decay, Mco, seeds) are not stated; no ablations; single runs
The VQA 80.16 comes from the METER-based V+L adapter with extra VLP on 14M images, not the pretrained model alone; comparison with SimVLM (80.03) is within 0.13

terms.definition: a pre-trained model and its adapters for solving all vision tasks in this Space-Time-Modality space, with transferability such as zero-/few-shot learning and fully fine tuning
